sections.title: Paramount Acquires Warner Bros. Discovery for $11 Billion in Cash, Creating Streaming Powerhouse
sections.lead: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison announced on March 2 the acquisition agreement for Warner Bros. Discovery at $31 per share in cash, totaling $11 billion in enterprise value.

sections.title: Apple Announces iPhone 17e and iPad Air M4 Simultaneously, Strengthening AI Device Lineup
sections.lead: Apple announced the new iPhone 17e ($599) and M4-powered iPad Air (11-inch $599, 13-inch $799) on March 2, with both devices featuring enhanced AI performance and significantly improved storage capacity.
